bull_bear.body:
- "Strong and under-levered balance sheet (CAR 34%+, D/E 1.54x) enabling significant growth headroom without equity dilution"; Capital Adequacy Ratio 34.8% in Q1FY27 (Q1FY26 32.9% | Q4FY26 36.1%).
- Tier I capital against RWA: total RWA 8,672 with the regulatory requirement "At least 15%" while "IndoStar maintain RWA as Tier I capital 34.8% as on 30th June 2026".
- Diversified borrowing profile across Working Capital Lines, Term Loan, Commercial Paper, Public Issue NCD, Private Placement NCD and Securitization, and investor categories Banks, NBFC, Mutual Fund, Corporates & Others and Retail.
- Liquidity: "Available Liquidity: 730 crs, Undrawn limit: 144 crs, Treasury Asset: 586 crs"; "Positive Cumulative Mismatch Across All Buckets" and "LCR maintained at 1.53x-1.78x of RBI mandate" with Avg daily LCR Q1FY27 of 153%.
- The deck states no dividend policy or payout.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Strong presence in two large, underserved segments - Used Vehicle Finance and Micro-LAP with first-mover advantage in several Tier-4 and Tier-5 markets and strong brand recall among core customer segments", with "High brand recall among transporters, small-business owners, and local communities".
- Describes itself as a "Retail-led NBFC focused on Vehicle Finance and Micro LAP" pursuing a "Transforming NBFC: Retail Centric & Tech Driven" agenda, including "Exit from Affordable Housing Finance - simplified portfolio and focus on core business".
- "Secured and granular portfolio with healthy yields of ~17% and improving cost of funds, driving stable NIM of ~8.8%" (Q1FY27 yield on loan assets is separately stated as 16.5%; NIM Q1FY26 6.2%, Q4FY26 8.7%).
- "Strengthened Risk Architecture, upgraded underwriting, customer selection filters, scorecard-based decisioning, aligned incentives and deployed early-warning systems", backed by an "Experienced leadership team with proven execution capability and deep sector experience".
- Large global private equity parentage: Promoters 70.36% - BCP V Multiple Holdings Pte Ltd (Brookfield) 55.97% and IndoStar Capital (Everstone) 14.40% as on June 2026.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Divestment] "Exit from Affordable Housing Finance"; Q1FY26 PBT & PAT include a gain on sale of the HFC business, shown as "Exceptional gain (net)" of 1,176.0 crs in Q1FY26 and FY26. IHFPL assets and liabilities were disclosed as held for sale / discontinued operations under Ind-AS 105.
- [De-focused book] "De-focused business includes corporate lending and SME Finance", with its AUM running down from ₹475 crs in Q1FY26 to ₹302 crs in Q1FY27.
- [Security Receipts] Gross Security Receipt ₹1,597 crs and Net Security Receipt ₹578 crs in Q1FY27, split Vehicle Finance ₹882 crs / ₹518 crs and De-focused business ₹715 crs / ₹60 crs, with % of Provision Covered rising to 64%.
- [Leadership] Randhir Singh is Managing Director & Executive Vice Chairman (31 years' experience, previously Deutsche Bank India Head, Edelweiss CEO of Commercial Lending & Structured Finance, Co-Founder and Jt. CEO of APAC Financial Services); several CXOs including CRO, CTO, CHRO and Head-Data Analytics show <1 year with ICF.
- [Risk governance] "Risk Appetite statement implemented as a strategic lever ... 150+ matrices tracked across business & functions with defined frequency", with ALM internal thresholds tighter than RBI for the 15 days-1 month bucket (-10% vs RBI -20%).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions IndoStar as a retail-centric, tech-driven NBFC focused on two underserved secured segments - used Vehicle Finance and Micro LAP - with first-mover advantage in several Tier-4 and Tier-5 markets, a 468-branch pan-India network and an under-levered balance sheet (CAR 34%+, D/E 1.54x) it says enables growth without equity dilution.
